spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && python scripts/exp012_ppl_depth_correlation.py --device cuda:0 --n_samples 500 --output_dir artifacts/exp012_results"

experiment_data.notes: ⚠️ artifacts/exp012_results.json 是 N=5 dry-run 测试数据（120 samples total），AUC 呈 0.04 步进伪影，无效。需 exp-004 完成后用 N=500 全量重跑。Binoculars performer 模型 ID 已修正为 allenai/OLMo-1B-0724-hf。脚本已验证。
experiment_data.hypothesis: Binary detector confidence (DivEye log-PPL + Binoculars ratio) 与 true depth 的 Spearman correlation，验证 binary confidence ≠ depth。Binoculars: observer=Pythia-1.4b, performer=OLMo-1B-0724-hf。
